actions.mautic_update_focus_item.descrip: Updates fields of a Mautic focus item.
actions.mautic_update_focus_item.props.a: Other focus item properties, e.g. "publishUp", "publishDown", "utmTags", "html". The dedicated props above win over the same keys here.
actions.mautic_update_focus_item.props.f: Form to show for the "form" type, from List Forms.
actions.mautic_update_focus_item.props.i: Numeric focus item id, from List Focus Items or Create Focus Item.
actions.mautic_update_focus_item.props.w: URL of the site the focus item runs on.
actions.mautic_update_form.description: Updates fields of a Mautic form.
actions.mautic_update_form.props.actions: Submit actions, each like {"name": "Add to segment", "type": "lead.changelist", "properties": {"addToLists": [1]}}. On update, actions with an "id" are edited and others added.
actions.mautic_update_form.props.additio: Other form properties, e.g. "cachedHtml", "template", "inKioskMode", "renderStyle". The dedicated props above win over the same keys here.
actions.mautic_update_form.props.alias.d: Form alias; Mautic shortens it to 10 characters and replaces spaces with underscores.
Form fields, each like {"label": "Email", "type": "email", "alias": "email", "leadField": "email", "isRequired": true}. Include a {"label": "Submit", "type": "button"} field. On update, fields with an "id" are edited and others added.
actions.mautic_update_form.props.id.desc: Numeric form id, from List Forms or Create Form.
actions.mautic_update_form.props.postAct: Message to show or URL to redirect to.
Updates fields of a Mautic marketing message.
Other marketing message properties, e.g. "publishUp", "publishDown". The dedicated props above win over the same keys here.
Channel settings keyed by channel, e.g. {"email": {"channel": "email", "channelId": 12, "isEnabled": true}, "sms": {"channel": "sms", "channelId": 3, "isEnabled": false}}.
Numeric marketing message id, from List Marketing Messages or Create Marketing Message.
actions.mautic_update_note.description: Updates fields of a Mautic note.
actions.mautic_update_note.props.additio: Other note properties. The dedicated props above win over the same keys here.
actions.mautic_update_note.props.id.desc: Numeric note id, from List Notes or Create Note.
actions.mautic_update_note.props.lead.de: Numeric id of the contact the note belongs to, from List Contacts.
actions.mautic_update_page.description: Updates fields of a Mautic landing page.
actions.mautic_update_page.props.additio: Other page properties, e.g. "publishUp", "publishDown", "isPreferenceCenter", "noIndex". The dedicated props above win over the same keys here.
actions.mautic_update_page.props.alias.d: Used in the page URL; generated from the title when empty.
actions.mautic_update_page.props.id.desc: Numeric landing page id, from List Landing Pages or Create Landing Page.
actions.mautic_update_page.props.redirec: Redirect used when the page is unpublished.
actions.mautic_update_page.props.templat: Theme name to build the page from, e.g. "blank".
actions.mautic_update_point_action.descr: Updates fields of a Mautic point action.
actions.mautic_update_point_action.props: Other point action properties, e.g. "repeatable", "publishUp", "publishDown". The dedicated props above win over the same keys here.
Points to add when the action happens; negative to subtract.
Point group to score in instead of the total, from List Point Groups (Mautic 5.1+).
Numeric point action id, from List Point Actions or Create Point Action.
Type settings, e.g. {"emails": [12]} for email.open or {"page_url": "https://example.com/pricing"} for url.hit.
Action type key, e.g. "email.open", "form.submit", "page.hit", "url.hit", "asset.download", from List Point Action Types.
actions.mautic_update_point_group.descri: Updates fields of a Mautic point group.
Other point group properties. The dedicated props above win over the same keys here.
Numeric point group id, from List Point Groups or Create Point Group.
actions.mautic_update_point_trigger.desc: Updates fields of a Mautic point trigger.
actions.mautic_update_point_trigger.prop: Other point trigger properties, e.g. "publishUp", "publishDown". The dedicated props above win over the same keys here.

What happens when it fires, each like {"name": "Add tag", "type": "lead.changetags", "properties": {"add_tags": ["hot"]}}. Types come from List Point Trigger Event Types. On update, events with an "id" are edited and others added.
Point group whose score is watched instead of the total, from List Point Groups (Mautic 5.1+).
Numeric point trigger id, from List Point Triggers or Create Point Trigger.
Score at which the trigger fires.
Whether contacts already at the score get the events.
Updates fields of a Mautic push notification.
Other web push properties, e.g. "button", "utmTags", "publishUp", "publishDown". The dedicated props above win over the same keys here.
Numeric push notification id, from List Push Notifications or Create Push Notification.
Page opened when the notification is clicked.
actions.mautic_update_report.description: Updates fields of a Mautic report.
actions.mautic_update_report.props.addit: Other report properties, e.g. "tableOrder", "graphs", "groupBy", "aggregators", "isScheduled", "scheduleUnit", "toAddress". The dedicated props above win over the same keys here.
actions.mautic_update_report.props.colum: Column keys to include, e.g. ["l.id", "l.email", "l.firstname"]. Get Report on an existing report shows valid keys.
actions.mautic_update_report.props.id.de: Numeric report id, from List Reports or Create Report.
actions.mautic_update_report.props.syste: Whether all users can see the report.
actions.mautic_update_role.description: Updates fields of a Mautic role.
actions.mautic_update_role.props.additio: Other role properties. The dedicated props above win over the same keys here.
actions.mautic_update_role.props.id.desc: Numeric role id, from List Roles or Create Role.
actions.mautic_update_role.props.isAdmin: Full access to everything; permissions are ignored.
actions.mautic_update_segment.descriptio: Updates fields of a Mautic segment.
actions.mautic_update_segment.props.addi: Other segment properties from the Mautic segment API. The dedicated props above win over the same keys here.
actions.mautic_update_segment.props.alia: Unique alias; generated from the name when empty.
actions.mautic_update_segment.props.filt: Segment filters, each an object such as {"glue": "and", "field": "email", "object": "lead", "type": "email", "operator": "like", "properties": {"filter": "%@example.com"}}. Without filters the segment has only manually added contacts.
actions.mautic_update_segment.props.id.d: Numeric segment id, from List Segments or Create Segment.
actions.mautic_update_segment.props.isGl: Whether other users can use the segment.
actions.mautic_update_segment.props.isPr: Whether contacts can join or leave it in the preference center.
actions.mautic_update_segment.props.name: Name
actions.mautic_update_segment.props.publ: Name shown to contacts in the preference center.
actions.mautic_update_sms.description: Updates fields of a Mautic text message.
actions.mautic_update_sms.props.addition: Other text message properties, e.g. "publishUp", "publishDown", "smsType". The dedicated props above win over the same keys here.
actions.mautic_update_sms.props.id.descr: Numeric text message id, from List Text Messages or Create Text Message.
Text to send. Tokens like {contactfield=firstname} are replaced per contact.
actions.mautic_update_sms.props.name.des: Internal name of the text message.
actions.mautic_update_stage.description: Updates fields of a Mautic stage.
actions.mautic_update_stage.props.additi: Other stage properties, e.g. "publishUp", "publishDown". The dedicated props above win over the same keys here.
actions.mautic_update_stage.props.id.des: Numeric stage id, from List Stages or Create Stage.
actions.mautic_update_stage.props.weight: Order of the stage in the lifecycle; higher is further along.
actions.mautic_update_tag.description: Updates fields of a Mautic tag.
actions.mautic_update_tag.props.id.descr: Numeric tag id, from List Tags or Create Tag.
actions.mautic_update_tweet.description: Updates fields of a Mautic tweet.
actions.mautic_update_tweet.props.additi: Other tweet properties, e.g. "publishUp", "publishDown". The dedicated props above win over the same keys here.
Asset to link, from List Assets.
actions.mautic_update_tweet.props.id.des: Numeric tweet id, from List Tweets or Create Tweet.
actions.mautic_update_tweet.props.page.d: Landing page to link, from List Landing Pages.
actions.mautic_update_user.description: Updates fields of a Mautic user.
actions.mautic_update_user.props.additio: Other user properties, e.g. "signature". The dedicated props above win over the same keys here.
actions.mautic_update_user.props.id.desc: Numeric user id, from List Users or Create User.
actions.mautic_update_user.props.passwor: Password for the user to sign in with.
actions.mautic_update_user.props.role.de: Role id, from List Assignable Roles.
actions.mautic_upload_file.description: Uploads a file to the Mautic media folders.
Optional subfolder inside the folder, e.g. "banners".

auth.description:
Follow these steps:

1. **Enter the Base URL:** Open your Mautic instance and copy the URL from the address bar. If your dashboard link is "https://mautic.ddev.site/s/dashboard", set your base URL as "https://mautic.ddev.site/".

2. **Enable Basic Authentication:** Log in to Mautic, go to **Settings** > **Configuration** > **API Settings**, and ensure that Basic Authentication is enabled.
